hints.title: Ordered Interval Intersection Check
hints.text: A new event [start, end) conflicts with an existing event [s, e) if and only if max(start, s) < min(end, e).

hints.title: Binary Search Adjacent Booking Check
hints.text: Store existing bookings sorted by start time. Check only the immediately preceding and succeeding intervals for collision before inserting.

hints.title: MyCalendar Book Blueprint
hints.text: In book(startTime, endTime): locate insertion position using bisect. If predecessor ends after startTime or successor starts before endTime, return False. Otherwise insert (startTime, endTime) and return True.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary search locates insertion slot in O(log N) while array shifting takes O(N).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full unsorted array scan takes O(N^2) total across N booking requests.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorted interval list allows quick collision verification on adjacent intervals.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Exact boundary collision logic max(start, s) < min(end, e).
